stem:
Read the list and answer the question that follows.

Section 215 of the USA PATRIOT Act of 2001
• Allows the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to search for "tangible things" without probable cause
• Allows search warrants to be issued for any U.S. citizen believed to be involved in terrorist activities

This act has caused conflict between —

options.label: F
options.text: individual rights and the authority of the government to maintain national security

options.label: G
options.text: equal protection under the law and protection of minorities against discrimination

options.label: H
options.text: economic stability and increased government spending on military readiness

options.label: J
options.text: promotion of free-trade policies and protections for workers in domestic industries
